page.layout: One printed page, no text blocks. The only marks are a library stamp in the centre and show-through from the reverse side.
page.notes: The page appears blank on its own side. The faint, mirrored lines of large capitals and small type (apparently "IOANNIS CALVINI" and related lines) are show-through from the other side of the leaf, so they are not transcribed. The circular violet stamp "BIBLIOTHEQUE PUBLIQUE DE GENEVE" is a library stamp and is omitted. Dark edges and a torn corner at the top and bottom are the scan's border, not printed matter.
